meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试 Senpi 适配器隔离运行，确保不污染真实环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改动过 Senpi 适配器代码，想要隔离验证却不想碰真实数据。
copy.tagline_en: Test the Senpi adapter in isolation without touching your real environment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the Senpi adapter and need isolated QA without touching real data.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会把 Senpi 适配器的质量检查做成一套固定流程:先解析出唯一的证据目录,再调用真实 senpi 二进制在隔离环境中运行对应的 QA 脚本,最后把结果和说明写入该目录,没有二进制就标记 SKIP。
howto.when: 当用户改动 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下的代码,或要求对 Senpi 适配器、任务/团队引擎、DAG 等进行 QA、验证或调试时;说出“senpi qa”“qa senpi”“test senpi adapter”等即可触发。

say.text: 运行 senpi-qa,验证 adapter 的改动。
say.note: 会跑自检和适配器驱动,生成证据。

say.text: 用 task-e2e 测一下任务生命周期。
say.note: 需要 SENPI_BIN 指向真实 senpi。

say.text: 检查证据目录是否合规。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns Senpi adapter QA into a fixed flow: resolve the single evidence dir, run the matching QA script against the real senpi binary in isolation, then write results and a README into that dir. If the binary is missing, it reports SKIP.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user changes code under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or asks to QA/verify/debug the Senpi adapter, task/team engine, DAG, etc. Phrases like 'senpi qa', 'qa senpi', 'test senpi adapter' also trigger it.

say_en.text: Run senpi-qa to verify adapter changes.
say_en.note: Runs self-test and adapter driver, writes evidence.

say_en.text: Use task-e2e to test the task lifecycle.
say_en.note: Needs SENPI_BIN pointing to the real senpi.

say_en.text: Check whether the evidence dir is valid.
say_en.note: Calls resolve-evidence-dir.mjs to resolve the path.
